title: Aadhaar Seva Kendra
section: 2. /   4. /   5. [Enrolment Ecosystem](https://uidai.gov.in/hi/enrolment-partners)   6. /   7. [Aadhaar Seva Kendra](https://uidai.gov.in/hi/aadhaar-seva-kendra)  # Aadhaar Seva Kendra  In the first phase of the Aadhaar Seva Kendra project, UIDAI has opened Aadhaar Seva Kendra in 78 districts across India. These include dedicated centres in all metro cities, all state capitals and Union Territories. These ASK will run along with over 66,000 Aadhaar Kendra already being run by banks, post offices, BSNL and state governments. Aadhaar Services available at Aadhaar Seva Kendra Aadhaar Seva Kendra offer a comfortable air-conditioned environment to individuals seeking to enrol and Aadhaar number holders. All ASK are wheel-chair friendly and have special provisions to service the elderly or specially-abled. ASK are open all 7 days of the week from 9:30 a.m. to 5:30 p.m. (IST). Individuals seeking to enrol and Aadhaar number holders can visit any convenient Aadhaar Seva Kendra for the following services:   *  Aadhaar Enrolment   *  Update of any Demographic Information in their Aadhaar - Name, Address, Gender, Date of Birth, Mobile number or Email Id   *  Update of Biometric data in their Aadhaar – Photo, Fingerprints and Iris Scans   *  Download & Print Aadhaar   *  Document update (POI and POA)  These services are available for any individuals seeking to enrol and Aadhaar number holders of India (including NRIs) at any Aadhaar Seva Kendra across the country. Online appointment for Aadhaar Services Along with the Aadhaar Seva Kendra project, UIDAI launched the online appointment booking facility for individuals seeking to enrol and Aadhaar number holders. All UIDAI-run Aadhaar Seva Kendra follow the online appointment system where any individual seeking to enrol or Aadhaar number holder can book an appointment for Aadhaar enrolment or update at any convenient ASK. Any individual seeking to enrol or Aadhaar number holder can book an appointment for themselves or a family member from [https://bookappointment.uidai.gov.in](https://bookappointment.uidai.gov.in/). This is a free of cost service where a individual seeking to enrol or Aadhaar number holder does not require Aadhaar registered mobile number. However, one individual seeking to enrol or Aadhaar number holder can book a maximum of 2 appointments in a month. Service Process at Aadhaar Seva Kendra As per defined model per district, the Aadhaar Seva Kendra have 4/8/16 operator stations with the capacity to handle up to 160/320/640 service requests per day.
